Discovery must support path-backed pages and hash-backed shell states, persist support-only routes as non-importable discovered truth, avoid hard delete during normal refresh, and never mutate curated hierarchy truth directly. V1 should use explicit root-triggered sync only; later scheduled or event-driven sync may build on the same model.

The feature must orchestrate approved providers, normalize returned surfaces, upsert discovered-surface lineages and observation rows, mark stale candidates safely, and reject client-supplied system-managed fields.

Authentication requirement: must not drop support-only truth just because it is non-importable

Business goal: Expose the current durable discovered-surface catalog so operators and downstream reconcile flows can inspect implemented app truth.
User outcome: A privileged root operator can retrieve current discovered surfaces with enough explicit metadata to tell what is user-facing, support-only, review-required, or possibly stale.
Notes / constraints: Reads must preserve the distinction between path-backed pages, hash-backed shell states, and support-only routes. The default read should not pretend unmatched surfaces are curated pages. Filter posture should favor explicit fields over vague search blobs.
Tenant context rule: root-operated discovery read capability outside tenant-scoped authorization; no tenant context applies
Explicitly denied roles: tenant actors; unauthenticated callers; authenticated root users without the governing capability

Backend enforcement rule: Root auth and root authorization must run before discovery reads. Feature reads must return explicit locator and classification fields, filter by root family disposition surface kind provider and stale posture, and exclude private provider internals that are not part of the contract.
Session / expiry behavior: Uses existing authenticated root-session expiry rules. No tenant session behavior applies.
Request contract: List query may include rootFamilyId surfaceKind userFacingDisposition providerKey staleStatus page and pageSize. Exact id param is required for exact reads.

Cross-feature seams: Later reconcile preview and drift-review tooling should consume these reads instead of reconstructing discovered truth from providers directly.
Persistence impact: Read-only access to current discovered-surface and run-linked metadata. No mutation.
Indexes / uniqueness: Indexes on rootFamilyId userFacingDisposition surfaceKind staleAt providerKey and lastDiscoveredAt support review filtering and pagination.
Search / filter model: List and exact reads by explicit fields only. No broad fuzzy search is required in v1.
Compatibility / migration notes: Default reads should stay compatible with later planner or reconcile UIs by preserving explicit locator shape and classification fields instead of flattening everything into one path string.
Authorization enforcement layer: Root auth middleware plus root authorization enforcement and feature-local exact and filtered read validation.

Privacy / personal data impact: Low; exposes internal app-structure metadata only to privileged root operators.
Standards impact: ASVS authorization relevance and anti-drift importance because these reads become the safe inspection seam for discovered app truth.
Acceptance notes: Capability is acceptable when a privileged operator can retrieve the current durable discovered-surface catalog with explicit locator and classification fields and without confusing discovered truth with curated hierarchy truth.

Notes / constraints: Apply must only use selected discovered surfaces or selected preview actions. Tenant context rule: root-operated hierarchy reconcile capability outside tenant-scoped authorization; no tenant context applies
Explicitly denied roles: tenant actors; unauthenticated callers; authenticated root users without the governing capability

Feature must validate selected discovery records and preview actions, create or update curated hierarchy rows safely, create or refresh explicit discovery-link rows, and reject attempts that would silently break compatibility or flatten truth layers.
Session / expiry behavior: Uses existing authenticated root-session expiry rules. No tenant session behavior applies.
